name: NeoForge
author: support@cinammon.net
description: NeoForge Server. NeoForge is a modding API (Application Programming Interface), which makes it easier to create mods, and also make sure mods are compatible with each other. NeoForge is a fork of Minecraft Forge.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# NeoForge Installation Script for Cinammon.net
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apk add --no-cache openjdk21-jre-headless curl jq

mkdir -p /mnt/server /mnt/server/mods
cd /mnt/server

NEOFORGE_VERSION="$(echo "$NEOFORGE_VERSION" | tr -d ' ')"
MC_VERSION="$(echo "$MC_VERSION" | tr -d ' ')"

if [ -n "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" ]; then
  if echo "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" | grep -q "1.20.1-"; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/forge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/forge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}"
    ARTIFACT_NAME="forge"
  else
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}"
    ARTIFACT_NAME="neoforge"
  fi
else
  if [ "${MC_VERSION}" = "1.20.1" ]; then
    XML_DATA=$(curl -sSL https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/forge/maven-metadata.xml)
    ARTIFACT_NAME="forge"
    NEOFORGE_OLD=1
  else
    XML_DATA=$(curl -sSL https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/maven-metadata.xml)
    ARTIFACT_NAME="neoforge"
  fi

  REPO_URL="https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/${ARTIFACT_NAME}/"

  if [ "${MC_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MC_VERSION}" ]; then
    NEOFORGE_VERSION=$(echo "$XML_DATA" | sed -n 's:.*<release>\(.*\)</release>.*:\1:p')
  else
    VERSION_KEY=$(echo -n ${MC_VERSION} | cut -d'.' -f2-)
    NEOFORGE_VERSION=$(echo "$XML_DATA" | grep "<version>${VERSION_KEY}" | tail -n1 | sed -n 's:.*<version>\(.*\)</version>.*:\1:p')
  fi

  if [ -z "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" ]; then
    echo "The install failed, because there is no valid version of NeoForge for the version of Minecraft selected."
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "NeoForge version: ${NEOFORGE_VERSION}"
  DOWNLOAD_LINK="${REPO_URL}${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/${ARTIFACT_NAME}-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}"
fi

echo "Downloading NeoForge version ${NEOFORGE_VERSION}"
echo "Download link is ${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"

curl -sSL -o installer.jar "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}-installer.jar"

if [ ! -f installer.jar ]; then
  echo "Error downloading NeoForge installer"
  exit 4
fi

rm -rf libraries/net/neoforged/${ARTIFACT_NAME} unix_args.txt

echo "Installing NeoForge server..."
java -jar installer.jar --installServer || {
  echo "NeoForge installServer failed"
  exit 5
}

ln -sf libraries/net/neoforged/${ARTIFACT_NAME}/*/unix_args.txt unix_args.txt

rm -f installer.jar

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  cat << 'EOF' > server.properties
server-ip=0.0.0.0
server-port=25565
query.port=25565
motd=A Cinammon.net NeoForge Server
EOF
fi

echo "NeoForge installation completed!"

variables.description:
The version of Minecraft you want to install for.

Leaving latest will install the latest version.

variables.name: NeoForge Version
variables.description:
The full exact version.

Ex. 20.4.194 or 1.20.1-47.1.95

Overrides MC_VERSION. If it fails to download the server files it will fail to install.
